claim: Try Takebook with three sample takes without reading or retaining real take data.
where: landing primary action, demo banner, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; seed one real IndexedDB row; enter ?demo=1; assert separate demo:takebook database, reset, and cleared demo data on exit

claim: Saved takes survive reload and reopen on this device.
sandbox: fresh demo context; record with computer keys; annotate; save; reload; reopen; compare note text

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
where: landing facts, connection status, privacy, README
sandbox: fresh demo context; wait for service worker; reload under context.setOffline(true); assert sample take and cached privacy page

claim: A take records for no more than 60 seconds.
sandbox: fresh demo context with Playwright clock; run recording past 60 seconds; assert 01:00.0 and automatic stop announcement

claim: Exports standard MIDI, synthesized WAV, and a JSON backup on the device.
sandbox: fresh demo context; download all three formats; assert MIDI and WAV signatures and three-record JSON

claim: Imports a valid Takebook JSON backup.
sandbox: fresh demo context; upload a complete valid take; assert success and visible imported record

claim: Computer-keyboard recording works when Web MIDI is unavailable or denied.
sandbox: fresh demo context; reject MIDI permission; assert recovery text; record a note with the A key

claim: The recorder supports a 390 px phone layout with 44 px piano targets.
sandbox: 390x844 browser viewport; measure all piano controls, spacing, and document overflow

claim: Normal recording, export, import, and legal-page use sends no recordings or tracking data off-site.
sandbox: fresh demo context; record all browser requests through app and legal routes; assert product origin only

claim: A valid Teacher pack license enables folders and printable practice sheets.
sandbox: fresh context with recorded valid Sociobot verification response; assert token storage, URL cleanup, folder enablement, print call, and daily cache

claim: The Teacher pack is a $9 one-time purchase through Sociobot/Dodo hosted checkout.
where: landing facts, Teacher pack, terms, README
sandbox: fresh demo context; assert price disclosure and exact Sociobot checkout endpoint without following it
